units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:13">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 9a:11">Pes. 9ᵃ</cite>, a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 11:7:5">Y. Yeb. XI, end, 12ᵇ</cite> <he>אינו נ׳</he> is not considered a non-viable birth (for legal purposes); a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="N01056"><he>נְפָלִים</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (play on <he>הַנְּפִלִים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:4">Gen. VI, 4</cite>) <he>שמלאו את העולם נ׳ וכ׳</he> they filled the world with abortions by their lascivious life. Tosef. l. c.; a. fr.
